import networkx as nx

# Construct the Petersen graph
G = nx.petersen_graph()

# Verify the properties
print(f"Number of nodes: {G.number_of_nodes()}")
print(f"Girth: {nx.girth(G)}")
degrees = [d for n, d in G.degree()]
print(f"Degrees: {degrees}")
